plain: A lawyer and activist, Dan Sheehan, brought up an old book on the podcast of host Jesse Michels. Sheehan says the book, When Worlds Collide, was written by a writer named Immanuel Velikovsky. He says it puts forward the idea that the asteroid belt, the ring of rocky debris between Mars and Jupiter, is what is left of a planet that was destroyed, which would mean our solar system had a violent past.
